metadata.title: On Poincaré spaces which are not manifolds
metadata.abstract: This expository note gives a short derivation of the classical Spivak normal fibration formula for the total space of a spherical fibration over a Poincaré duality space. We review the associated smooth, PL, and topological manifold realization criteria and illustrate them with examples from the stable stems. The principal application combines these criteria with the completed solution of the Kervaire invariant problem to identify the exceptional stems in a specified family of three cell Poincaré spaces.
metadata.comment: This paper is primarily expository. The author claims little originality for this note and does not intend to publish it in a peer-reviewed journal

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 这篇讲义型文章简短推导Poincaré对偶空间上球面纤维化总空间的经典Spivak法丛公式，回顾光滑、PL与拓扑流形实现判据，并结合Kervaire不变量问题的完成结果，确定某个三胞腔Poincaré空间族的例外稳定茎。
analysis.breakthrough: 整合经典实现判据并在指定三胞腔族中应用。
analysis.limitations: 作者明确称主要为阐释性文章，原创性有限且无意送同行评审；具体胞腔族与例外指标需正文确认。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
